stations.title: Bridie
stations.note: The office takes a few calls at once.

stations.title: Old program
stations.text: Rings the office one booking at a time

captions: Morning at the hut. The harbour office sends Bridie the day's bookings to confirm.
The old program confirms them one at a time, and the boat fills while she waits.
You share the bookings out over a few threads at once and read every answer.
The calls go out together, the bookings are confirmed, and a failed one is reported.
Bridie's bookings are confirmed before the boat fills, with every failure named.
